records.subject: Environment
records.title: Water Quality Of Catchment Waters, Annual
records.footnote: The inland water monitoring programme comprises 74 sampling locations in water catchment areas (flow into reservoirs) and non-catchment (flow out to sea) areas, with sampling carried out on fortnightly to quarterly basis. Water samples are analysed for a range of physical, chemical, biological and microbiological parameters, and benchmarked against international standards. National Environment Agency's guidelines for dissolved oxygen, biochemical oxygen demand, and total suspended solids in non-catchment waters are aligned with the ASEAN 2005 ASEAN Strategic Plan of Action on Water Resources Management of >=3 mg/l,
